title: Widen the pane-verb envelope with geometry origin, foreground cwd and agent status
action: The dispatch and merge roles branch on three pane fields the thc-3 envelope does not carry (found by the thc-5 worker): (1) `rect.x`/`rect.y` — the chat pane is 'the smallest x, ties on smallest y, excluding your own pane' (role-dispatch.md §3, role-merge.md §2); (2) `foreground_cwd` — the §4 anomaly scan, which role-dispatch.md:141 says must NOT be substituted by `cwd`; (3) `agent_status`/`agent_session` — the dead-session test at role-dispatch.md:169. Add them. In run.rs: `PaneGeom` (anchor `pub(crate) struct PaneGeom` ~396) gains `x: u64, y: u64`; `RealHerdr`'s layout parse (`extract_pane_layout` or wherever `rect.width`/`rect.height` are read — `rg -n "rect" run.rs`) also reads `rect.x`/`rect.y`; every existing constructor of PaneGeom (test fakes included — `rg -n "PaneGeom {" run.rs tmux.rs pane_verbs.rs`) gets `x: 0, y: 0` or real values. In tmux.rs: `RealTmux::pane_layout` lists `list-panes -t <pane> -F '#{pane_id} #{pane_left} #{pane_top} #{pane_width} #{pane_height}'` and fills x/y (update its stub-parse test). In pane_verbs.rs: `geom_json` adds `x`, `y`; `PaneRow` gains `foreground_cwd: Option<String>`, `agent_status: Option<String>`, `agent_session: Option<String>` and `pane_row_json` renders them (null when absent); the herdr `pane list` parse reads herdr's `foreground_cwd`, `agent_status`, `agent_session` fields (read `skills/bee-herding/references/role-dispatch.md` §4 and `spawn-proof.md` for the exact herdr field names, and `RealHerdr`'s existing list parse); the tmux parse fills `foreground_cwd` from `#{pane_current_path}` (tmux's pane_current_path already follows the foreground process, so on tmux `cwd` and `foreground_cwd` are the same value — say so in a doc comment), `agent_status` from the screen classifier on a bounded capture of that pane (idle|working|blocked, advisory per tmux-herding-transport D4; skip the capture and emit null when the row is not the caller's target to keep `list` cheap — implement as: `pane list` never classifies; a new subverb flag `pane list --with-status` classifies every row), and `agent_session` null. Update the envelope-key tests in pane_verbs.rs (the pinned-keys test for `layout` rows and `list` rows) and add parser tests: a tmux 5-field layout line → x/y/width/height; a herdr list body carrying foreground_cwd/agent_status → the row fields. Keep every existing verb flag and key; this cell only ADDS keys.
